atoms.b: Apostrophes can be used to show ((++possession quotations)).
We can add an apostrophe and an -s to ((++most all)) nouns.
When a noun already ends with an -s, we only add an ((++apostrophe exclamation_mark)).
Apostrophes are also used for contraction; when we want to ((++shorten lengthen)) a word or combine words.
